tldr: The Moon in Pisces: emotions are sensitive, porous, and spiritually imaginative.
body: With the Moon in Pisces, feelings move through intuition, dreams, compassion, music, art, and the unseen emotional field. Emotional safety grows when softness has boundaries.

note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
